resources.string: You are not taking part in a diary study yet. Scan the QR code of a study or type its join code.
Joining opens the consent form of the study. The app stores no name, e-mail address or phone number, and the study cannot see your other studies.
You left this study. The app will tell the researchers as soon as it has a connection.
The researchers have ended this study.
You will get no more questions. Your answers stay with the researchers unless you delete them with “Delete my answers”.
All your answers in this study are deleted, at the researchers too, and cannot be restored. The study is then removed from the app.
Allow notifications, otherwise the app cannot ask you at the right moment.
Allow \"Alarms & reminders\" so that questions arrive on time.
This question has expired. The next one will come.
You have reached today\'s limit for this report.
This study takes no new participants.
Something went wrong. Please try again.

The app keeps on this phone only the list of your studies with their schedules and, for each study, a random secret: the only key to your answers there. It has no account and sends no device ID, name, e-mail address or phone number. Nothing of it goes into backups or to a new phone.

Reminder: a short question is still waiting
Saved. Your answers will be sent as soon as the phone has a connection.

If a study lets you answer without a connection, the app also keeps the questionnaire pages of those questions and, until they are sent, the answers you gave without a connection; answers that could not be sent within 7 days are deleted.
No question at a random time comes during your quiet hours. A change applies from tomorrow and only to the questions at random times, not to those at fixed times.
If you set quiet hours for a study, the app keeps them and sends them to the server of the study, so that no question at a random time comes during them.
The study period is over. Please answer: %1$s
An answer you gave without a connection was not stored: today\'s limit for this report had already been reached.
The clock of this phone is wrong. Answers given without a connection will be sent once the date and time are set correctly.

You already take part in this study on this phone. Joining again starts a new participation: your earlier answers can then no longer be deleted in the app. Answers of the earlier participation still waiting are sent first if possible, otherwise discarded. To delete your earlier answers, cancel and use “Delete my answers” on the study’s page.
Notifications off – you will not get any questions
The study is removed from this phone. Afterwards you can no longer delete your answers through the app.
The final survey of this study is still open.
A newer version of this app is needed for your study. Please update the app so that your questions keep arriving correctly.
Answers on this page that have not been sent yet will be lost.
The page could not be loaded. Please check the connection and try again.
Hold the study’s QR code inside the frame
Without access to the camera the app cannot read a QR code. Type the join code below instead; it is printed under the QR code.
Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
Provider of the app and of the Askurious platform:
The answers in “%1$s” have been deleted.
The study period is over. Please still answer the final survey.
The study period is over. Please still answer the final survey (open until %1$s).
Printed under the study’s QR code, e.g. k7qm2x
The questions of your diary studies at the times the researchers chose, and their reminders
The study period is over. Please answer: %1$s (open until %2$s)
So that questions arrive on time
The app asks the study’s questions with a notification at the right moment. For that it needs two permissions; both can be changed later in the phone’s settings.
Without it questions may come a few minutes late.
